svg.title: A hybrid USB-C connector: through-hole pegs, surface-mount signal pins
svg.desc: Drawn to scale except copper thickness, side view of a USB-C receptacle on a 1.6 mm board. Its metal shell has two pegs that go through plated holes and are soldered through the board, which takes the force of plugging and unplugging. Its signal pins come out of the back and are soldered to pads on the surface.

g.text: Soldered through the board; take the plugging force
Soldered in reflow with the rest
Drawn to scale except copper thickness.
